articles.headline: Referee Curtis Blair to work NBA Finals, a first in his career
articles.description: Curtis Blair spent all day Friday checking his email. And Saturday. And Sunday. The list of referees that were selected to work the NBA Finals was about to be revealed by the league, and the waiting was brutal.

images.name: Curtis Blair first NBA finals [600x400]
images.caption: For the first time, Curtis Blair will work a game in the NBA Finals, becoming the only first-time selection in this year's group of 12 referees who will officiate the series between the San Antonio Spurs and New York Knicks.
